warp.bot: Use for delayed welcome/drip emails. Prefer prop onboarding-stage=done. Pass actions as JSON array: wait → send_email → halt. Campaigns remain for newsletters/backfill. enabled: pass 1 or 0.

inputs.name: Trigger type
inputs.bot: prop (contact property), segment, or manual (run_automation only).

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON array. Example: [{"type":"wait","config":{"delayMinutes":4320}},{"type":"send_email","config":{"subject":"…","body":"Hallo {{name}}","sentPropKey":"b2b-welcome-sent-at"}},{"type":"halt","config":{}}]. Wait config is only delayMinutes, a whole number of minutes (0 = immediate). At most one send_email.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Sending agent UUID. Required when actions include send_email. The agent must have email configured. There is no team-wide fallback.
